method.baseline: Compare upstream and DEImoji; calt off is an additional within-font diagnostic
method.warmup: Font loading and initial glyph drawing excluded; identical fonts reused, unique text per trial
method.timing: Forced DOM layout plus separately traced main-thread paint recording and raster-worker CPU
method.raster: Raster CPU sums worker time and can overlap main-thread work; do not add columns as wall time
method.flush: Screenshot ensures raster completion; PNG encoding, readback and transport are excluded from selected trace metrics
method.nowrap: Layout-only diagnostic: overflowing glyphs outside the viewport are not painted
method.control: Additional 3200-glyph calt-on layout samples without tracing, in both wrapping modes
method.limits: Headless Chromium in this environment, not a physical display or universal browser result
